Hi Jane — great questions. Looping in Aditya (Compliance) and Laura (Legal) to help with the questionnaire and BAA. Quick answers below, and next steps at the bottom.

Questions answered:
- Logs / retention: In hosted mode, we retain request/response logs for up to 30 days by default for debugging and abuse detection; customers can opt into shorter retention or disable storage for sensitive workloads. In Dedicated and Private deployments, logs remain within your tenancy and retention is configurable — we can set up retention policies consistent with your HIPAA requirements.

- KV / prefix cache: KV cache is in-memory at inference nodes to speed up repeated prefixes. It is not persisted to external analytics services. Telemetry (aggregate metrics) is exported to our monitoring stack; those metrics do not include raw prompt text. If you require, we can disable telemetry exports or route them to your VPC in Private deployments.

- SOC 2 report: Attached is a high-level SOC 2 Type II summary (redwood_soc2_summary_2027Q1.pdf). For the full report, we typically require an NDA or a secure report access link — Laura, can your team confirm the standard process / NDA template?

Next steps (proposed):
1) I'll schedule the technical follow-up for Tue 2027-04-20 10:00am PT with Aditya and our solutions engineer.
2) Laura / Legal to send standard NDA or BAA template to procurement.
3) Compliance to start completing the vendor questionnaire (we will return within 3 business days).

Jane — can you confirm procurement contact and whether INR (vendor risk platform) or a file upload is preferred for the questionnaire?

Thanks — Marissa

Attachments: redwood_subprocessors_20270415.csv, redwood_soc2_summary_2027Q1.pdf
